title: Cavity sensor open
fullDescription: Garland MCO detected open RTD on cavity probe. Heating disabled until sensor replaced.

fixSteps.title: Reseat connector
fixSteps.instruction: Power off and reseat sensor connector at board.

faq.a: Yes, both MCO-GS and MCO-ES use the same probe.

title: Over temperature
fullDescription: Hi-limit thermostat triggered. Stuck contactor or runaway probe possible.

fixSteps.title: Power off
fixSteps.instruction: Switch off at breaker, let cool 30 min.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: Tech tests contactor and replaces hi-limit.

faq.a: No, do not run until repaired.

title: Ignition failure
fullDescription: Spark module did not detect flame within trial period. Gas, ignitor, or flame rod issue.

faq.a: Press reset button on ignition module.

title: Convection fan motor fault
fullDescription: Fan motor not at expected speed. Possible bad capacitor or motor windings.

faq.a: Listen for hum without rotation = bad cap.

title: Door switch fault
fullDescription: Door reported open during cycle. Reed switch or magnet alignment.

title: Communication fault
shortDescription: Display board lost link to power board.
fullDescription: Lost serial bus. Reseat ribbon cable, replace board if needed.

title: Cooling fan fault
fullDescription: Electronics bay fan not running, components overheating risk. Replace fan.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: Tech replaces small DC cooling fan.

title: Memory checksum fault
fullDescription: EEPROM data corrupt. Programs may be lost. Reload presets after clearing.

fixSteps.title: Default
fixSteps.instruction: Run factory reset and reload presets.

faq.a: Use USB backup if model supports.

title: Voltage fault
fullDescription: Brownout or undervoltage detected. Have electrician verify circuit.

faq.a: A line conditioner or surge protector helps.
